verdict.rationale: The docs show Open Finance is organized into discrete products (account ownership verification, balance, transaction data, ACH details, payment prediction, etc.) that are called via separate endpoints, implying developers can integrate only the specific data product they need rather than one monolithic feed, and account/transaction data is further broken into 'data segments' varying by account type. However, there is no explicit documentation of a consent-scope selection UI, granular permission grants surfaced to end users, or stated data-minimization policy/controls tied to those product APIs. Missing for 10: explicit consent-scope selection mechanism in the Connect flow, documented end-user permission granularity, and a stated data-minimization policy.
